changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_role_permissions (base_role_id, base_permission_id, enabled) SELECT br.id, bp.id, 1 FROM base_roles br JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.code IN ('supplierinvoice.read', 'supplierinvoice.create', 'supplierinvoice.update', 'supplierinvoice.delete') WHERE br.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM base_role_permissions x WHERE x.base_role_id = br.id AND x.base_permission_id = bp.id);

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO membership_sub_modules (membership_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT m.id, sm.id, 1 FROM memberships m CROSS JOIN sub_modules sm WHERE sm.code = 'PURCHASES' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM membership_sub_modules x WHERE x.membership_id = m.id AND x.sub_module_id = sm.id);

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, c.id, sm.id, 1 FROM companies c CROSS JOIN base_permissions bp JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = 'PURCHASES' WHERE bp.code IN ('supplierinvoice.read', 'supplierinvoice.create', 'supplierinvoice.update', 'supplierinvoice.delete') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = c.id AND p.code = bp.code);
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM permissions WHERE code IN ('supplierinvoice.read', 'supplierinvoice.create', 'supplierinvoice.update', 'supplierinvoice.delete');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id, enabled) SELECT r.id, p.id, 1 FROM roles r JOIN permissions p ON p.company_id = r.company_id AND p.code IN ('supplierinvoice.read', 'supplierinvoice.create', 'supplierinvoice.update', 'supplierinvoice.delete') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id);
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM role_permissions WHERE permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE code IN ('supplierinvoice.read', 'supplierinvoice.create', 'supplierinvoice.update', 'supplierinvoice.delete'));
